## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face featuring a snubbed nose and a wide mouth. Though she previously wore her hair braided into innumerable plaits, her hair is now styled in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows genuine concern for her adored mistress's well-being.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) served as the young maid and helper to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She assisted with hosting guests, picking strawberries, and expressed deep concern to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over Miss Lavendar's despondency. Charlotta shared in the excitement surrounding Miss Lavendar's wedding preparations and planned a move to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston), later helping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tidy up the house following the marriage ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as the young helper and handmaiden to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta actively assists her mistress with entertaining guests, picking strawberries, and maintaining the household, while showing deep concern for Miss Lavendar's emotional well-being when she becomes despondent. She also works alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help prepare for Miss Lavendar's eventual wedding and tidy the home afterward.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +21 more_
